name: Chiptune / 8-bit
lineage: Late-1990s and 2000s electronic subgenre composed using sound chips from 1980s game consoles (Commodore 64 SID chip, Nintendo Game Boy LSDj software, Famicom NSF chip). Characterized by limited-polyphony square-and-triangle-wave timbres, fast tempo, and bright-melodic content reminiscent of 8-bit-era video-game soundtracks. Anamanaguchi, Crystal Castles (early use), Sabrepulse, Bit Shifter, and the broader 8bitpeoples netlabel anchored the canonical 2000s sound.
